scope_title: A settings screen you can navigate, trust, and verify

gate.rationale: P0 coverage is 100% and overall coverage is 91% (minimum: 80%), but P1 coverage is 86% (target: 90%).

freshness.note: Auth/authz gap closed after the run; heuristic finding only, so P0/P1/overall are unchanged. Epic 6 is untraced.

requirements.title: Four tabs; every field in exactly one; eight groups re-home per map
Single-request save; inactive tabs in DOM; other tabs unchanged
Errored tabs marked (not colour alone); first errored tab opens
#tab-{slug} deep link; no collision with page-level ?tab=
No-JS degradation; no field unreachable
Keyboard operability, visible focus ring, ARIA tab/panel relationship
Tab registration extensible without markup changes
Unconditional required markers + aria-required; HTML5 fields harmonised
Conditional markers match sanitize_settings() exactly
Errors adjacent to field + summary; programmatically associated
Failing field on collapsed tab opens and marks that tab
New strings translatable under skwirrel-pim-sync
Optional Context ID field on Connection tab with placeholder and help text
Context sent on getProducts, getProductsByFilter and getGroupedProducts
Empty context omits the parameter; existing installs unchanged
Changed context sets force-full-sync and tells the admin
Non-numeric/negative rejected with an inline error
Success reports round-trip, status and total products
Zero products reported as a warning, not a success
Failure still reports round-trip and status
No extra writes; auth token never in output (NFR-4)
Tabular figures; new strings translatable

gaps.summary: Fragment deep link asserted as a source substring only; no test drives a page load with #tab-{slug}.
Keyboard operation asserted as the string 'ArrowRight' in JS source; focus ring as a CSS selector's presence.

CLOSED 2026-08-26. Was: handle_test_connection_ajax() had no denied-path test. Four integration tests added (absent nonce, forged nonce, subscriber with valid nonce, SSRF pin); each asserts refusal, unchanged connection state, and no outbound HTTP request. Does not affect the gate percentages - this was a heuristic finding, not an acceptance criterion.
Context ID parameter name (include_contexts) pinned against mocks only; epics.md BLOCKED-UNTIL-CONFIRMED never cleared and sprint-status.yaml still records it as unverified.

recommendations: Confirm the Context ID API parameter name against the Skwirrel JSON-RPC docs and clear the marker in sprint-status.yaml, or add a recorded-response contract test.

Record the JS/CSS source-assertion ceiling for 5.1-AC4 and 5.1-AC6 as an accepted limitation, or extract the tab controller so those branches become unit-testable.
